design_philosophy: Functional clarity, high data density, sharp aesthetics for a complex hybrid marketplace. Information density must be high but optically clear using rigid grids, 1px borders, and high contrast typography.

physical_delivery.name: Delivery & P2P
physical_delivery.description: Used for physical movement of goods.

local_services.name: Local Services
local_services.description: Used for in-person trades and tasks.

remote_jobs.name: Remote Jobs
remote_jobs.description: MANDATORY 4TH COLOR. Used for fully remote opportunities.

rules.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, tracking-tight, font-black for H1, font-bold for H2-H3.
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans, text-sm to text-base, leading-relaxed for high readability.
rules.labels: Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and meta data.

layout_and_spacing.global_radius: rounded-sm (4px) to rounded-md (8px) maximum. No pill-shaped buttons.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders (border-collapse style) for definition.
layout_and_spacing.grid_dashboards: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Highly dense.
layout_and_spacing.grid_directories: Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 gap-8 for /stores and /restaurants.

components.buttons: Solid backgrounds, sharp borders, high contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
components.cards: Cardless approach preferred. Use border-b or 1px border-border/40 instead of soft shadows.
components.toast: Use Sonner. Polling toast for Provider Hub MUST be highly visible. Include 'Fly to Pin' action button inside toast.
components.map: Full bleed or large container. Map pins MUST use the 4 category colors. Add a distinct 'Remote-friendly' toggle (teal) above map.
components.media_upload: Drag and drop zone for photo/video. Use dashed borders and subtle background tint.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: CRITICAL: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, map pins, form inputs, toggles, toasts, tabs) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='provider-accept-job-button').

feature_implementation_instructions.provider_hub: Display live opportunity feed. Implement 15s polling. Sonner toast for new jobs in radius/category must contain title and miles. Clicking toast triggers 'fly to pin' on the map. Include internal wallet balance display with a 'Withdraw Funds' button.
feature_implementation_instructions.marketplace_and_requests: Service requests and marketplace listings MUST support optional photo/video attachments. Listings seamlessly forward to delivery requests with media_url and media_type fields.
feature_implementation_instructions.stripe_checkout: Implement bundled 10% deposit. The checkout UI must clearly visually split '10% Item Deposit' and '10% Delivery Fee'. Use test mode.
feature_implementation_instructions.roles_and_directories: Implement /stores and /restaurants directories. Each profile must show logo, hours, address, and an inventory CRUD grid.
feature_implementation_instructions.google_maps: Ensure map handles 4 colored pins. Add an instruction section in the Settings page detailing how to restrict the Google Maps API key in Cloud Console.
feature_implementation_instructions.pay_units: Job posting forms must support dropdown for Pay Unit: hour / day / week / flat.
